summary: Tested Demand Studio visibility and notifications features. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Demand Studio page loads correctly, shows posts from multiple companies, activity feed working, notifications being created.

GET /api/demand-studio/social/stats (lines 3275-3286): Correctly aggregates stats across visible_company_ids using '$in' filter
GET /api/demand-studio/social/insights (lines 3351-3363): Correctly builds visible_company_ids and uses '$in' for base_match
GET /api/demand-studio/social/calendar (lines 3474-3485): Correctly includes all company memberships in visible_company_ids
GET /api/demand-studio/social/ideas (lines 3531-3542): Correctly aggregates ideas from all member companies
POST /api/demand-studio/social/posts (lines 2863-2879): Correctly notifies all active team members when post is created
PATCH /api/demand-studio/social/posts (lines 3103-3125): Correctly notifies team members when status changes
